label: Auto Shoutout
tagline: Welcome incoming raids with an automatic shoutout.
description: When another channel raids in, the bot posts a shoutout pointing your chat at the raider. Turn the module on and customize the shoutout line.

native_shoutout.label: Also send Twitch shoutout
native_shoutout.help: Fires Twitch's own /shoutout on the raider alongside the chat line, which shows their current category and profile card natively. Off by default.

shoutout.label: Raid shoutout
shoutout.defaultMessage: Massive shoutout to {raider} for the raid with {viewers} viewers! Check them out at twitch.tv/{raider.login}
